name: Gong
description: Gong brings deep revenue insights into your Claude workflows, helping teams ask questions, generate briefs, and surface risks, objections, next steps, and stakeholder context from Gong AI OS data.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Gong to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Gong to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.gong.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Gong MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Gong provides these MCP tools: ask_account, ask_deal, generate_brief, and get_transcript.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Gong?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Gong in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Gong requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Gong is developed by Gong. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
